Hi Anna,

August close: Evergreen finished at 236 monthly active developers, within one standard Growth overage band. Usage is billed monthly by active developers—not purchased seats—under the existing terms: $7,500/month includes up to 200, with $1,000 per additional 50-developer band; August therefore carries one standard $1,000 overage.

AWS closed at about $18.9k and Pinecone at about $4.2k. Both look like normal monthly vendor hygiene.

Best,
Morgan
